items.title: 《战地 6》加入 Game Pass，30 美元微交易可立即解锁所有枪支
items.summary: It's a big day for Xbox Game Pass, as developer Battlefield Studios has launched Battlefield 6 into Game Pass,

content.v: It's a big day for Xbox Game Pass, as developer Battlefield Studios has launched Battlefield 6 into Game Pass, and it comes at a big moment for the game.
Battlefield 6 is now available for Xbox Game Pass Ultimate ($23/month) subscribers on PC and console. It can also be streamed.

The game's arrival in Game Pass is notable because Battlefield 6 was 2025's best-selling game overall in the US , and was released a year ago this month. The game had a very strong start, but player numbers have dropped. Battlefield Studios is attempting to reignite the fanbase in a number of ways, including bringing the game to Game Pass and continuing to support the FPS with big new updates. The latest of these, the Season 5 update , is out today, October 13 .

Season 5 adds a new maps, including environments set in Las Vegas and Area 51, while it also brings something fans have been asking for since launch: a proper server browser . Check out the gameplay trailer above to see the Season 5 content in action.

Additionally, Battlefield Studios announced a Game of the Year Edition for Battlefield 6. The biggest selling point for the GOTY edition is the Ultimate Shortcut Kit, which instantly unlocks everything for all four classes, along with one season of Battlefield Pro, among other digital perks and extras.
The Ultimate Shortcut Kit, which was also available in other previous Battlefield games, is available to purchase by itself for $30 .

content.v: 据 GamesBeat 报道，R星计划于 2027 年第一季度发布《GTA6》的 PC 版本。据悉，此消息得到了四位熟悉 Rockstar 工作室计划的业内人士证实。这四位消息人士均要求匿名，以免损害公司与R星的商业关系。
https://image.gcores.com/4f922ba17721b1d83104119f624fdc42-1000-563.webp
换言之，主机版独占期最短约一个半月，最长约四个半月。相比之下，《GTA5》的 PC 版在主机版发布一年七个月后才问世。由于本作的制作预算据称超过20亿美元，公司希望借此迅速扩大受众规模并加快变现。同时，PC 版能加速推进用户生成内容与在线模组。
R星于2023年8月收购了热门服务器FiveM的开发团队 Cfx.re 。Twitch 首席执行官 Dan Clancy此前表示，《GTA6》的在线模式将于明年推出。截至发稿前，R星尚未公布在线模式的官方上线日期。

content.v: RPD-elightful.

Capcom’s decision to release a bunch of modern Resident Evil games on the Switch via the cloud was controversial, to say the least. While I personally had a pretty positive experience with Resident Evil 2 - Cloud Version , it wasn't an ideal solution for RE fans on Switch. Thankfully, with the release of RE2 Deluxe Edition on Switch 2, we finally have a native version of a modern classic, and it’s brilliant .

In case you missed Capcom’s 2026 Switch 2 releases, the company has demonstrated mastery of Nintendo’s hardware, delivering games that look incredible and run well. That’s exactly the case here, too. Resident Evil 2 looks amazing, with sharp, clear visuals in both docked and handheld modes. Really, the only obvious drawback is the slight fuzziness of character hair, which is a lot more noticeable when playing handheld.

items.title: 尽管遭到一些官员的抗议，Rockstar 在《侠盗猎车手 6》发布前仍继续扩大对迈阿密的数百万美元收购
items.summary: Rockstar Games is continuing to ramp up GTA 6's massive marketing with a Vice City blimp, NFL promos, and much

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/ultimate-edition-squalo-01-1791903846462.jpg
Rockstar Games is continuing to ramp up GTA 6's massive marketing with a Vice City blimp, NFL promos, and much more, despite protests from some Miami officials.

For the last two months, Rockstar has been setting up marketing for what will likely be one of the biggest, if not the biggest, releases in entertainment history. It kicked things off with a massive gameplay reveal on Netflix , followed by a blitz of merch and add-ons such as an album featuring original music created for GTA 6 . Now, Rockstar is taking over the real world to help spread the word of what's to come on November 19.

Rockstar is currently focusing marketing on the city of Miami. GTA 6 takes place in a fictional version of Miami known as Vice City, so Rockstar is utilizing the city for a lot of its advertising, which has led to friction between city officials. Some are all for it, as they hope it attracts more tourism and generates increased revenue. Others, however, are strongly opposed and have been for weeks.

According to The Miamian, County Commissioner René Garcia has expressed displeasure over the marketing campaign for GTA 6 in Miami, reporting he's "really uncomfortable with this whole thing." Specifically, Garcia doesn't like that the city is collaborating with a "game that's depicting Miami like a crime haven; Miami like a murder capital.”

Garcia and other officials are reportedly attempting to squash negotiations with Rockstar to expand its marketing efforts for GTA 6 in the city, which allegedly include ads at Miami International Airport and a $4 million transformation of Miami Beach. The rollout was expected to begin as soon as October 15, but Miami journalist Joel Franco stated that an unnamed official doubts that deals will be finalized in time.

In September, Rockstar paid just shy of $1 million to install a massive, glowing "Welcome to Vice City" sign on top of the Miami Heat's arena, the Kaseya Center . The arena will also be home to an unprecedented NBA game sponsored by Rockstar Games. On November 18, the Miami Heat will play a regular season game against the Milwaukee Bucks on a Vice City-themed court with never-before-seen jerseys inspired by GTA 6 . The arena will also be selling Vice City merch, with Rockstar and the NBA labeling the event as a "night in Vice City."

Over the weekend, Miami's Hard Rock Stadium, the home of the Miami Dolphins, was covered in GTA 6 ads. The stadium's jumbotron featured ads for the game, promoting its release date. During touchdowns, the screen also had a GTA 6-themed animation with text that read "In for VI," in reference to the team scoring six points.
New image of Hard Rock Stadium #GTAVI marketing on the actual live cam screen via @golfoscar69 This is insane marketing. https://t.co/bgdUXDDXBE

Now, a blimp appears to be on its way to Florida as well. A Goodyear blimp with Vice City branding is currently flying out of Ohio and is reportedly on its way to North Carolina. It's speculated that it will eventually make its way to Florida, possibly during other sporting events or other planned marketing activations in the coming weeks. Rockstar has also put up at least one Vice City mural in Miami. It's clear Rockstar is ready to spend whatever it takes to get the word out and to effectively turn Miami into a real version of Vice City.

Goodyear Blimp with Vice City livery is currently flying south out of Akron, Ohio. Scheduled to stop in North Carolina this afternoon. Wondering if it’ll head to South Florida for the big marketing kickoff on Thursday? 👀 📸: Cecil Richmond/Goodyear Blimp Fan Club https://t.co/AloPE0LdVR
Meanwhile, there's plenty going on in the world of GTA 6, including an alleged PC release window , ongoing leaks , and much more.

content.v: Leon top form.

The original Resident Evil 4 is one of my favourite games of all time – if not my number one. I remember soaking in every detail before its release, with magazines chronicling its troubled development alongside Capcom’s shaky promise of GameCube exclusivity. When it launched in 2005, it devoured my every waking moment for the rest of the year, and I still regularly play it.

For a long time, I was of the opinion that it simply didn’t need a remake. It still looks good, it plays great, and I couldn’t imagine how Capcom could possibly do it justice. When my older brother, however, picked up the original for the first time a few years back, he dropped it almost immediately, repulsed by the ageing controls and mechanics. Was I wrong?

items.title: 据报道，Xbox 首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 表示，如果没有新 IP，“我们将无法生存”，随后进行了数百次裁员并取消了许多项目
items.summary: Having one's cake and eating it too is meant to be a metaphor.

content.v: Thousands of layoffs , a couple of booted studios, and a re-organisation of Obsidian away from its newer projects and onto Fallout later, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has reportedly taken to an internal town hall and talked about the importance of new IP.

The transcript, as shared by Windows Central , goes as follows: "We're backing our strongest franchises. I want our great games to become great global billion-dollar franchises. I would also like to see us continue to create enduring new IP. We will not survive if we only revive [sic] on the past. We have to find new ways, and courage, to have invention on new IP, that reaches new sets of audiences."
This is, to put it gently, very confusing. As part of Xbox's "Reset", the studio has done the following:

That doesn't smack to me of the kind of courage and new IP invention that Sharma is talking about—most of these studios had either just made interesting new IPs (South of Midnight) or are in the business of doing cool, inventive new stuff (Double Fine).

From a numbers-driven point of view, were they making bank? Likely not, but the phrase "trying to have your cake and eat it too" exists for a reason. The mouth isn't talking about what the hand is doing—waxing lyrical about courage and new IP while making some of the most cutthroat industry cuts we've seen in an already-dire decade.

The one counterpoint to this is that Xbox has picked up Hideo Kojima's Physint . Which is technically a new IP. Not an IP that Xbox personally funded the most of, and it's being created by a beloved auteur, but hey. There is that.

All of this isn't to say what seems to be Xbox's actual strategy—"backing our strongest franchises", as Sharma puts it—isn't understandable from that same ruthless abacus point of view. But given how sore its existing developers understandably feel from the sword dangling over their heads? I'd leave that town hall very confused.

items.title: Xbox 正在测试一项新的 Streak 功能，该功能可能会让游戏感觉（更多）像是一件苦差事
items.summary: It looks like another new Xbox feature is in development, and this time, it's designed to encourage users to g

content.v: It looks like another new Xbox feature is in development, and this time, it's designed to encourage users to go on a hot streak--of using their console, not disrupting a sports event with a quick birthday-suit-run.

Spotted by Game File's Stephen Totilo , a new number appears to be popping up on the dashboard of Xbox users who are signed up for the Xbox Insider program, suggesting that a streak counter is in development. Microsoft hasn't formally announced this feature yet, and it looks like it kicks in after using your Xbox for three days in a row per week. It's an idea that Microsoft has experimented with in the past through Game Pass and the Xbox mobile app, but never to this extent with a prominent display of how many days in a row you've dedicated to playing Xbox games.

Is there any benefit to Streaks for Xbox users? Totilo's research suggests that it could be tied to Xbox reward points, which can be redeemed for digital items and Xbox gift cards. On Microsoft's side, this could also be a subtle way to keep users engaged more consistently, since the lure of a score streak is powerful. Just look at Wordle, with its subtle emphasis on keeping your streak going, or mobile free-to-play games that offer daily login rewards to tempt you to sign in regularly.

That could be good, bad, or irritating depending on how it is implemented, as Xbox users could find themselves regularly pinged on their progress while they're in the middle of a game. Your tolerance mileage might vary when it comes to these notifications, so hopefully there's an opt-out option if Streaks roll out. But as Totilo noted, just because Xbox is testing this new streak function doesn't mean it'll be implemented across the Xbox ecosystem in the future. The fine print for Xbox Insiders mentions that these features may not become "permanent additions" to Xbox.

One new addition to Xbox that has been confirmed are Mythic Achievements , which are designed to be proof of your accomplishments in a given video game. Similar to PlayStation Platinum Trophies, a Mythic Achievement is earned whenever all of the original achievements for a game have been earned.

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132245465756.png
第四代Apple TV 4K的核心升级在于A19芯片。相比上一代，其CPU性能提升最高50%，GPU性能提升最高2倍，为Siri AI的流畅运行提供了算力基础。新品内置三枚远场麦克风，支持“Hey Siri”或“Siri”免遥控器唤醒，配合高级回声消除技术，即便在播放音频时也能清晰识别语音指令。

Siri AI带来的是全新的全屏交互体验。用户可以提出“今年有哪些Apple TV节目拿了艾美奖？”这类问题，Siri AI会直接从Apple TV应用中调取海报图和相关推荐。观看过程中，用户还可以追问拍摄地点或节目是否适合特定年龄段，回答以紧凑的浮层形式呈现，不打断观看。若搭配支持Apple Intelligence的iPhone，Siri AI还能利用个人上下文，直接响应“播放Alinda推荐的那个节目”这类模糊指令。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132245549186.png
此外，新款Apple TV 4K首次支持由四台HomePod mini 2或HomePod（第二代）组成的环绕声系统，并可作为家庭中枢，在Home应用中提供由Apple Intelligence生成的摄像头活动描述和通知摘要。
苹果在新闻稿中明确表示：“Siri AI将以测试版形式登陆第二代及更新款Apple TV 4K。”这意味着2021年发布的第二代（A12仿生芯片）和2022年发布的第三代（A15仿生芯片）用户，通过即将推送的tvOS 27.2更新即可获得Siri AI功能。
Siri AI正式推出时，将首批支持美国、澳大利亚、加拿大、印度、新西兰、新加坡、南非和英国的英语用户。Siri AI在新硬件上的表现无疑会更出色，但老机型获得支持，也让现有用户不必为了体验新功能而立即升级。
第四代Apple TV 4K即日起在美国及其他29个国家和地区开启预购，售价299美元，约合人民币2000元，将于11月13日正式发售。

items.title: 据报道，AMD 已经提高了其显卡合作伙伴的 GDDR6 价格，因此 Red Team 的 GPU 价格飙升不会让您感到安慰
items.summary: Getting worse before it gets better.

content.v: We all know RAM and SSD prices have been significantly impacted by the memory supply crisis. But it's easy for some to forget just how much dedicated memory modern graphics cards rock these days. And when I say 'some' I mean those not still trying to hunt down a reasonably priced Nvidia RTX 5090. Alas, it sounds like the broader situation shows no signs of improvement.

Unfortunately for its Add-in Board partners, AMD has reportedly raised its prices for the GDDR6 memory that comes with its GPUs. According to sources on Chinese forum Boardchannels, the price increase took effect October 1 (via Benchlife ).

If AIBs are having to pay more for AMD GPUs, they'll likely also raise their prices and pass the expense on to the consumer. Long story short, PC gamers will likely have to spend more on team red's wares in the near future. We've been actively monitoring graphics card prices for some time now , and sadly this is far from an unusual development.
Back in July, Nvidia made a similar move with the pricing of its GDDR6 and GDDR7 cards . Reports followed that Nvidia graphics card prices were rumoured to increase by as much as 30% .

In August, our Dave advised gamers to " avoid any Nvidia card with more than 8 GB VRAM, if you value your bank balance ". It's also not just memory prices gamers have got to worry about when it comes to graphics cards, but increasingly limited supply too . Indeed, RTX 5090s have been particularly hard to find at US retailers online .

While celebrating the RTX 4090's fourth birthday earlier this week, rumours swirled that Nvidia had reportedly halted GeForce RTX 5090 production in favour of AI data centre GPUs . There's much ink I could spill on the AI industry's role in the memory supply crisis more broadly, but AMD and Nvidia are having to raise prices for reasons beyond that too. For instance, various components, such as the PCB , are also going up in price due to the war in Iran.
Bottom line, it's a tough time to be a PC gamer looking for a reasonably priced upgrade.

items.title: 人工智能无法制作《星球大战：银河赛车手》中的比迪·布拉斯
items.summary: Epic's upcoming Star Wars shooter is reportedly developed with an "AI first" production model, which means it'

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/biddy-blas-blogroll-1791900576841.png
This is an IGN opinion piece from Mat Jones. He loves weird little guys in video games.

If your social feed is anything like mine, it’s been overtaken by a weird little crocodile man that’s knee-high to a Tauntaun and has an unresolved rage twelve times his size. His name is Biddy Blas , he’s one of Galactic Racer’s supporting cast, and he’s the best new thing to happen to Star Wars since Andor.
Give an AI as long a time as it needs: it couldn’t have made Biddy Blas.

With every new day, the ground underneath video games as a medium, one where professional creatives are valued and capable of negotiating an honest living, feels more and more unstable. Perfectly good studios are shutting in the name of brand restructuring. Electronic component prices have no incentive to reduce . The cost of producing anything is rising due to the precarious supply of energy and the push to end physical ownership . It’s hard to imagine what the future of the medium looks like, regardless of AI’s role to play in it.

But look, I’m not a doomer – games continue to exist in spite of these truths because of the passion of the people involved. They’re also often better than they’ve ever been. Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a highlight for the under-served genre of arcadey high speed racer, with surprisingly in-depth vehicle customisation, heat management and opponent rivalry systems.

It’s hard not to think about how good it is in the context of Epic Games’ apparent push for an "AI first" production model . Such a pivot has reportedly delayed a secret Star Wars and Marvel crossover shooter, which will apparently be developed with AI tools on both the coding and art sides of the project.

I can’t speak to the quality of a supposed game that is an indefinite time away from release, especially one that no one outside of the Epic offices has seen a frame of, but I can’t see this approach being able to emulate Galactic Racer’s secret weapon. For all the arguments of efficiency, accuracy, and speed, I don’t think a Large Language Model has the capability to create a breakout character. AI cannot make a Biddy Blas.

Blas is an icon. He’s the perfect example of what Star Wars fans have dubbed a “Glub Shitto”; not important enough to the narrative to be a main character, but so arresting in their limited screen time that they become your favorite anyway.

At this point you may be thinking, “Surely a bit of computer code could come up with an angry crocodile in a hat?” And maybe it could. Arguably the main thing that makes Blas so perfect is his ridiculous voice, and AI companies have gone to great lengths to ensure its products can do voices. But, as The Blood of Dawnwalker’s lead actor Will de Renzy-Martin put it on a recent episode of My Perfect Console , “the least interesting thing about what I do is the way my voice sounds”.

"[AI]’s not replicating my personality and the things that I do when I'm in the room, and the choices that I make, which is all the reasons that a director or a producer would want to work with me” said the actor behind Dawnwalker’s protagonist, Coen. "Actors are pretty cheap in the grand scheme of things. And if you end up with an AI that can produce the right noises, you're going to need somebody who can interact with it and get the performance that you want attached to those noises – and they're going to be much more expensive than an actor is."

To put it another way: an AI might have been able to write a nonsense Huttese catchphrase, but only Galactic Racer’s specific writers could have decided one of those sounds was “Scrib Doon”, and only Biddy Blas’ performer, Richard Summers-Calvert, could make the inspired decision to deliver the line as ridiculously as he did. And it’s that combination of creative human decisions, that living understanding of what’s genuinely funny, that turned Biddy Blas from a collection of script and polygons into an icon.

No one can prove a counter-factual, sure; I don’t see the same outpouring of love happening if we outsourced seemingly small decisions like these to the computer. As an anecdote, there’s no reality where my partner would be interested in having a Star Wars racing game hogging the home telly; the Biddy Blas game is an entirely different proposition.

Maybe Epic’s new production pipeline makes sense for a company that has spent the past decade turning Fortnite into a platform more than a game, one that increasingly eschewed creative flair and originality as a driving force (a much ruder critic would say this has never been the ambition at all). The Fortnite of today is now primarily a hub for other brands to throw their licenses at. If the priority of Epic is to focus on streamlining the production process for cramming in things which already exist, an “AI first” approach might seem obvious. If you’re making a Star Wars and Marvel shooter, there are plenty of reference materials for both of those properties to train an AI on. I would simply argue there weren’t reference materials for either… before they existed.

It’s not just Star Wars that needs Weird Little Guys created by Actual Cool People. Players are picking up Valve’s hybrid MOBA-shooter Deadlock in record numbers following its most recent patch, inspired largely by the exciting amount of creative flair displayed by the new inhabitants of the increasingly graphically-realised cursed New York City. Characters like the Rat King, who has hundreds of individually written and performed dialogue barks naming a different one of his rodent subjects for every time one of his abilities is used, or the Chess-hustler Solomon, whose weapon is a board showing historically important endgames chosen by the design team which change depending on the maximum amount of ammo in his magazine. Without people making deliberate decisions, having completely original character ideas, people would not have the same incentive to log in daily to go 0-8 in lane. (Although I hate being in games with these powerful new characters, so maybe this is actually a bad example.)

I see the continued use of AI in ideation and initial production as an existential issue for the medium that we’ll one day be course-correcting away from in the same way it would have seemed obvious to CEOs to chase the seemingly inevitable draw of live-service, online passes and on-disc DLC. For all of the efficiencies in the process, for all the promise of profitability, I’m not sure how you can actually sell any of this stuff without the unique spark of newness. I’m talking about this from a purely cynical marketing perspective: If I’m just going to get stuff I’ve already seen, it’s stuff I already have.

items.title: 《恶魔城》新作获GS 10分爆赞!有望成系列史上最佳
items.summary: 就在刚刚，GameSpot公布了《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》的评测，并为游戏打出 10分满分。

content.v: 就在刚刚，GameSpot公布了《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》的评测，并为游戏打出 10分 满分。
评测认为，本作将战斗、探索、环境谜题与剧情巧妙融合，几乎所有核心要素都达到了出色水准，有望跻身《恶魔城》系列史上最优秀的作品之列。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131512335029.png
评测优点：
- 战斗设计精妙： 招架系统与攻击机制配合出色，战斗节奏迅速流畅，甚至让原本不喜欢招架玩法的评测者彻底改观。
- 探索体验出色： 在巴黎街道、地下区域与德古拉城堡之间穿梭十分畅快，探索工具兼具移动与战斗功能。
- 武器与能力丰富： 多种武器类型和技能提供了充足的搭配空间，玩家可以根据自己的喜好打造战斗风格。
- 环境谜题设计巧妙： 谜题既能带来适度挑战，也能补充角色背景与剧情信息。
- 塔罗牌系统整合玩法： 塔罗牌将剧情线索、探索指引、角色互动、Boss追踪与法术能力串联起来，让各个系统形成完整的整体。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131512438842.png
评测缺点：
- 主角塑造稍显平淡： 女主角萝丝虽然坚定可靠，但人物性格缺少变化，相比身边个性鲜明的配角，显得不够有趣。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131512537820.png
GameSpot在评测中表示，《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》并没有像《恶魔城：月下夜想曲》那样彻底改变系列，而是将各项玩法打磨到出色水准。
评测尤其称赞了战斗系统：招架不会打断普通攻击，玩家可以一边进攻、一边招架敌人的攻击，再利用钩索迅速接近敌人，形成攻防一体的高速战斗体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131513016230.png
游戏还拥有色彩鲜明的美术风格、设计各异的Boss以及大量可探索内容。评测者游玩约20小时后，牌组中仍有不少Boss尚未找到，探索动力始终充足。
最终，GameSpot认为本作有望与《月下夜想曲》并列，成为系列乃至银河城类型游戏中的经典之作。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130940508334.png
据俄罗斯媒体Playground报道，与《GTA6》泄露事件相关的代币项目CYBERLEEK经历大幅波动。在此前市值一度突破600万美元后，该代币目前市值已跌至约245万美元，近24小时价格下跌超越50%。
此前，CYBERLEEK曾因围绕《GTA6》泄露内容进行炒作而受到关注。项目方此前承诺，当代币达到指定市值目标后，将公开相关内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130940597249.png
10月12日晚，在达到此前设定的阶段目标后，CYBERLEEK发布了一段声称为《GTA6》角色露西亚的4K大尺度视频，并以此作为项目宣传的一部分。
不过，即便兑现了这一承诺，CYBERLEEK的市场表现仍未出现预期增长，反而出现明显下跌。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130941099542.png
目前，项目方仍继续将未来内容发布与代币市值绑定，并将3000万美元市值作为下一目标。据其此前说法，若达到这一目标，将公开一份包含完整剧情流程的《GTA6》可游玩版本。
不过，相关说法尚未得到任何官方确认。此前围绕《GTA6》的多次泄露事件中，也曾出现利用未公开内容、假消息或相关炒作吸引关注的情况。
随着CYBERLEEK市值快速缩水，外界也开始关注该项目后续动向：项目方是否会继续发布所谓“泄露内容”，或这场围绕《GTA6》的迷因币炒作是否会随着热度下降而结束，目前仍有待观察。

此外，“数字版 午夜黑 日本专用”已被追加为PS5主机2年保修活动 的对象机型。在 2027年3月31日 前购买指定PS5主机，原本1年的厂商保修将延长1年，合计可享2年保修。

items.title: 一条小团团抖音直播突遭封禁！游戏角色穿得太清凉
items.summary: 一条小团团抖音直播突遭封禁！游戏角色穿得太清凉

content.v: 知名游戏主播一条小团团近日直播《绝地求生》（PUBG）时，直播间突然遭到短暂封禁，引发观众关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131556024530.png
据玩家社区流传的消息，平台给出的违规提示涉及画面出现“大尺度形象”，而触发审核的原因疑似与游戏角色所穿的皮肤有关。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131556092419.png
当时小团团正在正常进行游戏直播，画面中的游戏角色穿着较为清凉，随后直播间便弹出了违规提示，并被暂停直播约10分钟。发现问题后，小团团及时更换了角色形象，但仍然受到短暂处罚。不过封禁时间结束后，她便继续开播。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131556187655.png
这一插曲也引发了部分观众对直播审核机制的讨论。有网友认为，如果问题确实来自游戏内的角色皮肤，那么主播未必存在刻意展示敏感内容的行为，直接触发处罚难免让人觉得有些突然。不过，也有人指出，直播平台需要对实时画面进行AI内容审核，游戏画面同样可能受到相关规则约束。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131556252166.png
小团团此前凭借《绝地求生》直播积累了大量人气，转至抖音后也继续进行游戏直播。此次短暂中断并未明显影响直播间热度，仍有大量观众在线观看。

content.v: 据微博博主达克鸭唐爆料，国内一名玩家疑因想买《GTA6》，最后和老婆离婚了。值得一提的是，今年9月时，曾有外媒爆料，因为女主露西亚性感， 国外很多女性禁止自己的男朋友游玩《GTA6》 。

事情的大致经过是这名玩家想买《GTA6》，老婆表示只要他发抖音视频，得到200个人的同意就买。结果在条件达到后，媳妇反而后悔了……
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261013/1791901307_130493.jpg

items.title: 据报道《GTA 6》登陆 PC 的时间将比预期早得多
items.summary: The November launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 will leave PC gamers sitting out in the cold, but the wait for the y

content.v: The November launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 will leave PC gamers sitting out in the cold, but the wait for the yet-to-be-announced PC port might be surprisingly short this time. According to a new report, GTA 6 will launch on PC "within the first three months" of 2027.

Speaking to GamesBeat , industry sources claim that Rockstar Games plans to launch the game just a few months after its console release. If the reports are accurate, this would mark a major departure for Rockstar Games, as previous PC ports arrived long after their original console releases. GTA 5, for example, landed on PC 18 months after its PS3 and Xbox 360 release, while the PC version of Red Dead Redemption 2 appeared 11 months after its PS4 and Xbox One release.

Take-Two Interactive boss Strauss Zelnick previously commented that PC was becoming an important platform for the GTA 6 parent company to focus on, saying sales of the publisher's PC games had increased dramatically over the years.

As for why GTA 6 won't be available on PC at launch, former Rockstar producer John Ricchio theorized that a console-first approach to development would give Rockstar more room to build a PC version later . Since consoles have limited hardware, it's easier for a studio to expand a game to run on more powerful hardware like a PC instead of scaling back to fit console constraints.

Rockstar hasn’t officially said anything about GTA 6 on PC yet, and the game officially lists only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S as its platforms. Xbox also recently clarified that GTA 6 will not be streamed to PC through Xbox Cloud Gaming , despite initial reports that Microsoft had secured exclusive streaming rights.

items.title: LGBT魔爪Sweetbaby官网删光合作方！DEI金主跑了？
items.summary: 近日，游戏咨询公司Sweet Baby Inc.（SBI）对其官方网站进行了彻底改版，引发外界关注。

content.v: 近日，游戏咨询公司Sweet Baby Inc.（SBI）对其官方网站进行了彻底改版，引发外界关注。
据博主@MasteroftheTDS发文称，SBI移除了此前展示的游戏作品与服务内容，取而代之的是一个几乎空白的黑色页面，仅保留Logo和联系按钮。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130918228278.png
该博主还透露，他与妻子@WritingRaven2发现，此前据报道拥有16名员工的SBI，如今在魁北克官方商业记录中仅列为 1至5人。
@MasteroftheTDS在推文中提问：“Sweet Baby Inc.是单纯想重塑品牌、与之前的项目保持距离，还是这背后预示着更深的财务困境？”
评论区中，多数观点倾向于认为SBI正面临经营压力。
有网友表示：“看起来他们遇到了财务麻烦。为什么原来16人只剩下5人？很可能裁员了。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130918478975.jpg
也有人提出另一种可能：“他们可能仍在以‘合同工’形式雇佣那些被裁员工，也就是隐藏雇佣。这样既能继续从行业里获利，又不用承担雇主风险。”
另有评论称：“免费的钱用完了，业务萎缩，但我怀疑服务仍在继续。”
也有网友直言：“我只希望他们最终破产。”
截至目前，Sweet Baby Inc.尚未就网站改版及员工人数变化作出公开回应。相关情况仍有待进一步确认。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130919081409.jpg

items.title: 任天堂非常不满马斯克扮演瓦力欧：演成变态了
items.summary: 两位前天堂公关经理Kit Ellis和Krysta Yang在近期的YouTube节目中透露

content.v: 据IGN报道，两位前天堂公关经理Kit Ellis和Krysta Yang在近期的YouTube节目中透露，2021年埃隆·马斯克主持《周六夜现场》时扮演瓦力欧的小品，让任天堂当时“非常不高兴”。两人回忆，小品播出时他们正在天堂工作，内部对此的反应是“not beloved”，也就是“不受待见”。Ellis还指出，小品的时间点也很奇怪——当时根本没有新的瓦力欧游戏或相关产品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131435394607.png
这个小品中，马斯克饰演的瓦力欧在法庭上被指控谋杀马里奥。但最让任天堂感到不适的，是小品中一系列低俗笑话。Ellis表示，这些内容对一家以家庭友好形象为核心的公司来说，已经“越界”了。任天堂对自己的角色被塑造成变态形象感到不悦，完全可以理解。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131435496490.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131435506215.png
两人是在聊到SNL最近另一段小品时提起这桩旧事的。那段新小品让《塞尔达传说》的林克和《GTA6》的杰森同台辩论谁的游戏更好，整体上是在调侃塞尔达、抬高GTA6。Ellis和Yang认为，这段新小品虽然也引发了一些争议，但“大概比马斯克那版要好得多”。

items.title: 被逼出来的新旗舰！RTX 5080 24GB定档2027 Q1
items.summary: 被逼出来的新旗舰！RTX 5080 24GB定档2027 Q1：价格1.5万

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131036176605.jpg
据报道，由于英伟达将GB202核心优先分配给利润更高的专业显卡，游戏产品线失去旗舰，原本被搁置的RTX 5080 24GB方案被迫重新启用，成为被逼出来的新旗舰。该型号预计2027年第一季度面世。
规格方面，RTX 5080 24GB沿用GB203核心，拥有10752个CUDA核心。显存从16GB GDDR7升级至24GB，位宽保持256-bit，整卡功耗约415W。
该卡并非全新设计，而是原本规划为RTX 5080 SUPER但因显存成本暴涨被搁置的型号。英伟达将其重新推出，以填补高端游戏显卡的空缺。
RTX 5090等高端型号逐步停产，这导致游戏产品线出现旗舰空缺。同时，显存成本暴涨叠加AI需求挤占产能，高端游戏显卡的供应和定价逻辑已发生根本改变。
尤其是价格，这是玩家最关心的。RTX 5080 16GB首发价为999美元，24GB版本预计零售价在1999至2999美元（约合人民币14300至21500元）之间。
国内渠道中RTX 5080 16GB实际售价已从8299元公版指导价涨至约12000元，24GB版本大概率直奔15000元以上。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131036241497.jpg
对于游戏玩家而言，RTX 5080 24GB将是2027年全年能买到的最高端GeForce显卡。显存从16GB升级至24GB固然是进步，但旗舰性能整体后退，价格却大幅上涨，玩家选择空间进一步收窄。

items.title: 《影之刃零》确认四大难度各有千秋！你开荒选哪个?
items.summary: 《影之刃零》此前在专场活动中公布了游戏的四种难度模式，分别为“入阵者”“破局者”“逆天者”和“六十六天”。近日，有玩家发帖…

content.v: 由你来说： 备受关注的国产动作游戏 《影之刃零》贴心地为玩家们准备了四种不同体验的难度，你一周目开荒打算选哪一种呢？
《影之刃零》此前在专场活动中公布了游戏的四种难度模式，分别为“入阵者”“破局者”“逆天者”和“六十六天”。
近日，有玩家发帖讨论一周目应该选择哪种难度，不少玩家表示，打算先以普通难度熟悉游戏，再挑战更高难度。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131152598461.png
据制作人梁其伟此前介绍， “入阵者” 模式注重直观体验与战斗表演，让玩家感受到自己成为武林高手的爽快感。而对于希望挑战自身实力的玩家， “逆天者” 模式则融入了格斗游戏的设计思路，头目不再完全依赖固定套路，而是会调整走位、惩罚玩家破绽，并根据玩家的出招习惯实时调整应对方式。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131153162322.png
作为终极挑战， “六十六天” 模式拥有与“逆天者”相同的战斗强度，同时将主角魂的66天生命倒计时融入游戏流程。玩家每进行四次战斗就会损失一天时间，一旦天数归零便会永久死亡，为挑战增添了额外的生存压力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131153362143.png
对于一周目难度选择，有玩家认为，先以普通难度通关，再在二周目挑战“六十六天”，更适合完整体验游戏的战斗设计。这样既能熟悉敌人的招式，也能在后续挑战中体验会根据玩家习惯调整行为的头目。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131153479276.png
其他玩家则有不同安排。有人表示高低难度都值得体验，因为不同难度下敌人的AI表现也存在差异；有人认为难度可以随时切换，不必过于纠结；还有玩家计划先以普通难度通关、获取武器，再挑战“逆天者”，最后将“六十六天”留到全成就之后。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131153568715.png
从目前的讨论来看，玩家对难度的选择并不完全取决于战斗强度，也与武器收集、熟悉机制和挑战目标有关。对于希望体验完整战斗系统的玩家而言，先熟悉基础招式、再挑战会主动适应玩家习惯的头目，或许是比较稳妥的开荒路线。

content.v: 注： 本文主要内容出自海外媒体 GamingBible的一家之言， 《影之刃零》最近闭门试玩的实机和媒体试玩报告均已曝光， 请大家自行浏览的同时理性看待外媒观点。
近日，海外游戏媒体GamingBible发布了《影之刃零》的前瞻报道。作者在体验游戏超过6小时后，对作品给出了极高评价，甚至认为它有望成为 史上最佳动作游戏 。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610102154082635.png
《影之刃零》由灵游坊开发，以中国文化与功夫为灵感，构建了一个融合武侠与朋克风格的“功夫朋克”世界。开发团队曾将其描述为一场精彩的动作冒险，而此次试玩也让媒体对游戏的战斗系统有了更深入的了解。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610102158233953.png
GamingBible总结了游戏的六大亮点：
1. BOSS战阶段进度保留
击败BOSS的一个阶段后，游戏会保留相应进度。即使玩家在后续阶段死亡，再次挑战时也能从上次到达的阶段继续战斗，避免反复从头挑战。作者认为，这一设计不会削弱战斗挑战性，反而能让玩家更专注于战斗本身。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610102158348501.png
2. 无需反复刷怪升级
虽然游戏包含部分类魂元素，但并不要求玩家通过反复刷怪收集材料来提升等级。被击败的敌人不会重新出现，玩家也不会因为等级不足而被迫刷取资源，必要时只需适当强化武器。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610102158452559.png
3. 甄子丹参与动作设计
电影演员甄子丹不仅在游戏中出演角色，还参与了部分动作场景的指导与动作捕捉工作。GamingBible特别称赞了游戏的动作编排，认为开发团队在呈现华丽战斗的同时，也努力保留真实武术的质感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610102158554932.png
4. 流畅多变的战斗系统
游戏允许玩家格挡、弹反和闪避，还加入了特殊闪避技“鬼步”，能够在躲避攻击后迅速发动强力反击。玩家还可以同时装备两把武器，每把武器拥有独立的耐力条，在防御即将被击破时切换武器，继续维持战斗节奏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610102159086939.png
5. 丰富的武器与自由强化机制
试玩中，媒体体验了多种武器，包括不同长度和重量的剑，以及能够在战斗中让使用者进入醉酒状态、以独特轨迹攻击敌人的蛇剑。
此外，玩家可以退还已经投入武器升级的材料，并将其用于强化其他武器。这意味着玩家无需担心升级资源被固定在某一把武器上，可以根据战斗需求自由调整玩法。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610102159286698.png
6. 名为“影之武装”的特殊辅助武器
除了常规武器，游戏还拥有一系列名为“影之武装”的特殊装备，其功能更接近战斗道具。例如，巨型斧头能够破坏敌人的盾牌，喷火狮头面具则适合应对多个敌人。这些装备同样可以升级，鼓励玩家根据不同战斗场景尝试多种组合。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610102159485630.png
GamingBible表示，经过此次超过6小时的试玩，作者对《影之刃零》的正式版充满期待，并认为其战斗流畅度、武器多样性和动作设计都有潜力让作品在动作游戏领域脱颖而出。

items.title: 《影之刃零》某个Boss有足足四个阶段！需寻应对之策
items.summary: 近日，知名游戏主播Maximilian在观看IGN发布的《影之刃零》试玩前瞻视频时，分享了自己此前参与游戏试玩时的一段经历。

content.v: 由你来说： 《影之刃零》为玩家打造贴心设计：无需重打已经通过的Boss阶段，你怎么看这一设计呢？会影响Boss战的节奏体验与击败Boss的成就感吗？
近日，《影之刃零》关于Boss战机制的新消息引发玩家讨论。根据官方介绍，如果玩家在Boss战中已经击败了第一阶段，但在第二阶段失败，重新挑战时可以直接从第二阶段开始，无需再次重复击败第一条血条。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131223492806.png
相关消息公布后，在 海外玩家社区 引发热议。有玩家表示， 《影之刃零》终于回归了传统动作游戏的设计思路 ，更像《忍者龙剑传》《鬼泣》《猎天使魔女》等强调爽快战斗的作品，而 不是单纯依靠重复挑战Boss磨练玩家。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131226556053.png
也有玩家认为，这种设计对于不熟悉魂系玩法的玩家更加友好，可以降低游戏门槛。 但部分追求挑战的玩家希望官方能够提供关闭该机制的选项，或者让高难度模式保留完整Boss挑战流程以保证击败Boss的成就感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131226444546.png
一位玩家表示：“我理解这是为了让没有魂系经验的玩家更容易通关，但如果能提供关闭选项，我会更满意。”
另一位玩家则认为，Boss战的意义在于通过不断失败学习机制，如果直接跳过已经击败的阶段，可能会削弱战胜敌人的成就感：“希望能像《鬼泣》一样，让玩家自由选择适合自己的体验。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131223243135.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131223256805.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131223256954.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131223266924.png
此前，S-Game曾表示，《影之刃零》的目标并非制作一款传统魂系游戏，而是融合高速动作、武侠战斗与格斗游戏元素。此次Boss机制调整，也体现出游戏希望同时兼顾动作游戏玩家和魂系玩家的设计方向。

content.v: 此前我们曾报道，索尼互动娱乐（SIE）宣布，将于2026年11月19日推出PS5新配色 “数字版 午夜黑 日本专用”，建议零售价为 55,000日元（含税）。注意，该机型为日本限定机型，仅支持日语。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131549171917.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131549194299.jpg
官方同时明确，2028年1月前发售的实体光盘游戏不受本次变更影响，玩家能够继续正常使用。当前没有任何信息显示索尼计划撤回该决策。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131549371654.png
从索尼官方的态度来看，索尼推进数字化转型的态度已经十分清晰，你认为PS主机实体光盘还有救吗？评论区聊聊你的看法。

items.title: PSN韩国突遭大范围涨价 SIE韩国：问了总部 已读不回
items.summary: 据韩国媒体GameMeca 10月12日报道，韩国PlayStation Store近日对多款游戏进行价格上调，其中包括《艾尔登法环》等热门作品，游戏内…

content.v: 据韩国媒体GameMeca 10月12日报道，韩国PlayStation Store近日对多款游戏进行价格上调，其中包括《艾尔登法环》等热门作品，游戏内付费货币也同步涨价。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130929207883.jpg
主要游戏涨价情况：
《艾尔登法环》：从64,800韩元涨至79,800韩元，涨幅约23%
《仁王 Remastered Complete Edition》《仁王2 Remastered Complete Edition》：均从54,800韩元涨至64,800韩元
《遗迹 II》：从54,800韩元涨至64,800韩元
《极乐迪斯科– The Final Cut》：从44,800韩元涨至49,800韩元
《控制 共振》：从64,800韩元涨至79,800韩元
《致命躯壳II》：从54,800韩元涨至64,800韩元
《真·三国无双2复刻版》：从49,800韩元涨至59,800韩元
《Absolum》：从29,800韩元涨至31,800韩元
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131105286345.jpg
整体涨幅在2,000至15,000韩元之间。
免费游戏的内购货币同样受到影响。《第一后裔》中5,750卡利弗的价格从109,800韩元涨至129,800韩元，上涨20,000韩元。《原神》等作品也以类似比例上调了付费货币价格。
GameMeca向SIE韩国询问此事，得到的回复是：“数日前已向总部确认事实，但目前尚未收到答复。”
一位匿名发行商相关人士表示，虽然理解索尼可根据汇率自行设定价格，但本次涨价并未事先通知，令人感到不合理。
涨价原因目前尚不明确。GameMeca指出，若单纯由汇率变动引起，韩国PS Store上大多数游戏都应受影响。然而，索尼第一方作品如《漫威金刚狼》《战神》等价格保持不变，因此难以将原因简单归结为汇率波动。

items.title: 曝《GTA6》PC版明年初就出！多名业内人士透露
items.summary: 据GamesBeat报道，四名不愿公开身份的行业知情人士透露，Rockstar内部规划《GTA6》PC版本将于2027年第一季度推出，R星官方在报道发…

content.v: 据GamesBeat报道，四名不愿公开身份的行业知情人士透露，Rockstar内部规划《GTA6》PC版本将于2027年第一季度推出，R星官方在报道发布前并未回应GamesBeat的置评请求。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132214163012.jpg
报道分析，《GTA6》开发预算传闻突破20亿美元，Take-Two需要尽快挖掘游戏全部商业潜力，PC玩家群体是重要增量市场。另外R星在2023年收购FiveM开发团队，而《GTA》系列的RP角色扮演服务器、玩家自制UGC内容完全依托PC平台运行，提前推出PC版，也是为未来游戏内玩家创作生态做铺垫。Twitch首席执行官此前也在采访中提及，《GTA6》线上模式预计2027年推出。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132214262896.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132214296518.png
报道同时强调，该时间仅为现阶段内部计划。R星对作品品质把控严格，《GTA6》已经经历两次延期，PC版同样需要达到主机版同等质量标准才会正式上线，发售窗口仍存在变更可能，该信息并非官方确认。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132214462305.png
当然，仍需再三强调的是，以上消息均来自外媒的爆料，并未得到官方的确认，因此建议大家理性看待。

items.title: 曝《GTA6》实体版送收藏地图！实体党这次有福了
items.summary: 曝《GTA6》实体版送收藏地图！实体党这次有福了

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130904379400.jpg
近日，据外媒ComicBook报道，《侠盗猎车手6》的实体版可能会附赠一张实体收藏地图，引发玩家关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130905245156.jpg
此次消息来自美国游戏零售商GameStop。据称，部分门店出现了有关游戏实体版的宣传信息，其中提到购买实体版将获得一张“实体收藏地图”。相关照片随后被发布到Reddit，并在社交媒体上流传。发布者还表示，自己曾进入门店询问工作人员，对方也确认了这一说法。
不过，目前这项消息仍未得到Rockstar Games或GameStop官方正式确认，地图的具体样式、尺寸以及是否包含游戏世界中的完整地图信息，也尚未公开。因此，现阶段还不能确定所有实体版本是否都会附赠该物品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610130906002322.jpg
对于《GTA6》玩家而言，实体地图并不只是普通赠品。系列过去的实体版本曾通过地图、说明书等印刷物增强收藏体验，而随着游戏发行逐渐转向数字化，实体包装中的附加内容也越来越受到关注。如果这次爆料属实，实体版或许能为喜欢收藏游戏周边的玩家提供额外吸引力。

content.v: 《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》的媒体评价已经解禁，OC站目前开分87分，媒体推荐率高达97%。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131515543635.png
PlayStation Universe 10/10分
各方面都出类拔萃，《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》是2026年必玩游戏之一。在佳作频出的一年里脱颖而出并不容易，但Evil Empire在这个游戏史上最具历史意义的系列之一中打造出了一部真正的杰作。
PPE.pl 9/10分
《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》是对这个传奇系列的精彩回归，将罗斯·贝尔蒙特出人意料地引人入胜的个人故事与出色的探索、高要求的平台挑战和令人满意的战斗相结合。Evil Empire并未打算革新这一类型，而是出色地利用了久经考验的基础，提供了惊艳的视觉效果、出色的敌人和平衡极佳的游戏玩法。这正是粉丝们多年来一直期待的那种《恶魔城》，也证明了科乐美选对了团队来让贝尔蒙特家族回归。
Oyungezer Online 7.5/10分：
对于这样一个长期运行的系列，在如此漫长的缺席之后，《贝尔蒙特的诅咒》是一次足够扎实的回归，如果你给它一些时间，它会成为一段愉快的体验。然而，由于没有为该类型带来新想法，它始终无法超越一款优秀的类银河恶魔城游戏。

items.title: PS6爆料大汇总：芯片已生产 开发机要来了
items.summary: 关于索尼下一代主机PlayStation 6的爆料信息正变得越来越密集

content.v: 关于索尼下一代主机PlayStation 6的爆料信息正变得越来越密集。尽管索尼官方至今未公布任何确切的发售时间与定价，但来自AMD内部文件、硬件爆料人Kepler_L2以及多家外媒的信息已拼凑出一幅相当清晰的轮廓。
据GameGPU报道，索尼已完成PS6所用混合处理器的设计工作，芯片成功通过了关键的流片（tape-out）阶段。这意味着芯片的最终拓扑结构已锁定，设计工作全部完成，光掩模文件已交付给半导体代工厂用于物理制造。流片成功确认了硬件平台开发周期中不存在关键延迟，接下来将进入硅工程样品的制造阶段，用于测试稳定性和组装开发套件。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131538213187.png
行业预计，首批PS6开发套件（devkit）将在近期陆续提供给索尼内部工作室及合作游戏团队。早期开发套件将允许开发者优化游戏引擎、校准图形管线，并为新架构提前准备高预算首发作品。

综合Kepler_L2等多方爆料，PS6将采用AMD Zen 6 CPU架构（7-8颗Zen 6c核心加2颗低功耗Zen 6 LP核心）和RDNA 5 GPU架构，采用台积电3nm工艺。GPU配备52至54个RDNA 5计算单元，理论FP32浮点算力约40 TFLOPS，光栅化性能达到PS5的2.5至3倍，光追性能提升幅度可达6至12倍。内存方面，爆料指向最高40GB GDDR7，160-bit总线，带宽约640GB/s，部分文件显示30GB配置。整机功耗约160W。
作为对比，微软下一代Xbox Helix据传GPU算力约56 TFLOPS，纸面数据领先PS6约40%，但实际游戏中这一差距不足以让帧率翻倍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131538338119.png
多方爆料显示，索尼将高度依赖AI技术来缩小硬件成本与性能目标之间的差距。PS6有望搭载新一代PSSR超分辨率技术，系统可先以1080p原生分辨率完成基础渲染，再通过AI模型实时升频至4K输出，降低约七成图形负载。此外，PS6还可能引入虚拟帧插值（VFI） 技术，目标在主机平台实现4K 120FPS的游戏体验。据报道，PS6的本地AI和高级语音识别功能也已在规划中。

关于PS6掌机的传闻同样密集。代号 “Project Canis” 的新一代掌机据传将与PS6主机大致同期于2027年末推出。硬件上采用3nm AMD处理器，配备16个RDNA 5计算单元和24GB LPDDR5X内存，可原生运行PS4、PS5及PS6游戏。据Vandal报道，该掌机可能以600欧元左右的价格发售。与仅支持串流的PlayStation Portal不同，这是一款具备本地计算能力的独立掌机。
价格是目前PS6传闻中最大的变数。Kepler_L2在今年3月估算PS6物料成本约为760美元，当时他认为索尼若愿意补贴，699美元的零售价仍有希望。然而仅三个月后，他将物料成本上调至约960美元，涨幅达26%。据GameGPU报道，如果索尼放弃硬件补贴，PS6零售价可能落在900至1200美元之间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131538404809.png
涨价的核心原因是全球内存和存储芯片短缺。Jefferies银行的分析师预测，RAM和SSD在2026年第三季度将涨价40%至50% ，第四季度再涨30%至40% 。索尼CEO十时裕树已公开表示，公司不打算以大幅亏损的价格销售硬件，但正在“密切监测市场”。行业分析认为，若内存价格维持高位，PS6最终定价1000美元可能已是最乐观的预期。
据IGN和Wccftech报道，多位分析师认为标准版PS6将不内置光驱，这符合索尼从2028年1月起停止生产实体光盘的战略方向。业内普遍推测，PS6大概率沿用PS5 Pro的商业模式——主机本体不含光驱，光驱作为可拆卸配件单独售卖。
发售时间方面，芯片流片成功使得2027年底的发售窗口变得更加可信。索尼已预定了台积电3nm产能，芯片制造计划于2027年第二季度启动。传统上索尼选择在年末假日季发售新主机，2027年11月被视为最可能的时间点。不过，也有分析师认为内存成本压力可能导致索尼推迟至2028年甚至更晚。
需要强调的是，以上所有信息均来自未经索尼官方确认的爆料与泄露，实际规格、发售时间与定价仍需以官方公布为准。

items.title: 女友答应买《GTA6》却言而无信 老哥直接想通分手
items.summary: 女友答应买《GTA6》却言而无信 老哥直接想通分手

content.v: 玩家囧事： 为了让女友给自己买一份《GTA6》，一名国内玩家按照约定凑齐了抖音视频的200个点赞，结果对方事后反悔。男子最终选择分手，事情曝光后引来大量网友围观，不少人不仅没有劝和，反而纷纷恭喜他及时脱离苦海。
网友原本希望女友能够为自己购买《GTA6》。然而，这份礼物并没有直接得到答应，对方提出需要凑齐200个点赞才能买。男子随后努力完成了这个目标，却依然没能兑现承诺，双方关系也因此走向结束。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131721052543.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131721121177.jpg
事件引发讨论后，评论区很快变成了网友给老哥打气的现场。有人直言，恋爱中的伴侣应该互相理解、尊重爱好，而不是拿条件反复限制对方；还有人认为，买一款游戏属于相对有限的娱乐开销，只要不影响正常生活，就没必要上升到“这么大的人还想着打游戏”的程度。
也有网友分享了自己的恋爱经历。有人的伴侣会主动支持自己买游戏、升级电脑，甚至认为另一半有喜欢的东西是一件值得开心的事。评论中还有人表示，找对象不一定要对方和自己爱好完全一致，但至少应该尊重彼此的兴趣。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131721209053.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131721204530.jpg
值得一提的是，该网友后来还表示，自己收到了不少网友的私信，有人提出直接给他买游戏，也有人想为他众筹，不过他都婉拒了，并感谢大家的好意。
这场风波也让不少玩家感慨：一份游戏礼物本身并不一定有多重要，真正让人难受的可能是约定被打破，以及自己的爱好长期得不到尊重。
你觉得这名老哥因为这件事分手，是太冲动了，还是及时止损？如果伴侣不喜欢你的爱好，你认为双方应该互相迁就，还是至少要做到不干涉？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131722203436.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131722217239.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610131722214675.png

content.v: 距《GTA6》发售日（11月19日）还有一个多月，其预购数据已受到业内持续关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132203203954.png
据市场分析机构Sensor Tower于10月13日更新的数据显示，《GTA6》累计预购量已达608万份，累计预估营收5.94亿美元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132203265809.png
从平台分布看，PlayStation平台贡献约451万份预购、占比74%；Xbox平台为约157万份，占比26%。两大平台的预购收入差距同样明显，PS端预购收入4.41亿美元，Xbox端为1.53亿美元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132203376229.png
以当前预购规模推算，《GTA6》发售后的首轮销量表现值得期待，这份成绩单也将成为衡量本世代主机市场热度的重要参考。

items.title: 《战地6》第五赛季现已上线 51区新地图或藏有彩蛋
items.summary: 《战地6》第五赛季将加入51区地图。参与赛季内容制作的创意团队成员被问及地图是否藏有彩蛋时，表示自己无法确认，也无法否认。地图中究竟有没有隐藏内容，目前仍未确定。 《战地》并不像你想的那样总是一本正经。多年来，这个系列一

content.v: 《 战地6 》第五赛季将加入51区地图。参与赛季内容制作的创意团队成员被问及地图是否藏有彩蛋时，表示自己无法确认，也无法否认。地图中究竟有没有隐藏内容，目前仍未确定。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261013/1791899765_625303_jpg_r.jpg
《战地》并不像你想的那样总是一本正经。多年来，这个系列一直有些傻气，也与彩蛋结下了不解之缘。如果你不熟悉这个说法，彩蛋就是藏在游戏里的笑话或秘密。
光是《战地6》，就已经像一本彩蛋集锦：罕见的换弹动画回来了，能驾驶的沙发也回来了。第五赛季将推出的一张地图设在51区。我想大家都知道，那是个充满谜团、许多事情秘而不宣的地方，很适合再藏点东西。
我采访了尼古拉斯·邦布雷。他是赛季创意团队的一员，这支团队负责为《战地》玩家构思新体验。我问起了游戏里的那些秘密。
“我既不能证实，也不能否认51区里有任何彩蛋。”对于51区藏了什么好东西，邦布雷的回答颇有几分这些年来美国政府的口吻。我还想知道，把秘密放进《战地》究竟是怎样一个过程：设计进行到哪一步时，会有人因为喜欢《忍者神龟》，提议在隧道里放几个披萨盒?
“这件事没有固定的做法。这正是彩蛋有趣的地方。”邦布雷接着说，有时员工会先做了再说：“有时候，有人谁也不告诉，就自己把东西做出来，再拿来给大家看。我们会想，哦，我们该把这个放进游戏吗?我们能把它放进游戏吗?”
这些年来，《战地》里可供发现的小惊喜渐渐有了几分神秘色彩。不管是巨齿鲨，还是山里的雪人，如今恐怕没人会只匆匆扫一眼《战地》的地图，就不再多看几眼。那四根棍子是什么意思?那些砖为什么那样堆着?那是外星人的头骨吗?
我觉得邦布雷知道些什么，只是我没法证明。“它们总会以某种方式出现，”他说。看来我得把51区仔仔细细搜个遍了——说得好像我原本不会这么做似的。
官方新闻：《战地风云6》第5赛季 全面 战争 席卷拉斯维加斯大道
《战地风云 6》全新地图：拉斯维加斯大道
战火已蔓延至拉斯维加斯，一切皆有可能：这里是玩家的视野开阔区和大规模载具战的天堂，拥有标志性的拉斯维加斯大道、喷泉和豪华赌场。从屋顶滑索进入酒店大楼，深入腹地，并在下水道中进行近距离战斗。尽享混乱，感受狂野，纵情狂欢。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261013/1791900237_490799_jpg_r.jpg
《战地风云 6》全新地图：51 区
51 区已被攻破。这座绝密沙漠 军事 基地，为各支小队提供了展开大规模战斗的无限可能。地表战场由载具主宰，战斗机、直升机和坦克随时准备投入攻防。穿过新形成的弹坑，深入基地的秘密地下隧道，在近距离交火中尽情挥洒战意。驾驶越野摩托车飞跃山丘，操控战斗机掠过沙漠景观。摧毁空中交通管制塔，改变战场局势，探索 51 区隐藏的秘密与军事科技。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261013/1791900237_392103_jpg_r.jpg
禁区冲突全新急速大逃杀模式
拉斯维加斯进入大逃杀模式。在全新禁区冲突模式“急速大逃杀”中，进攻就是一切。击杀敌人。赢取重新部署机会。空降多张地图，在人数更少的对局中展开激战，争夺装有游戏中顶级战利品的空投，并直面收缩速度最快的火圈。高光更多。攻势更猛。对局更快。速战速决。
全新《战地风云 6》 | 禁区冲突武器
Mk 24：在开阔战场的交火中占据上风。Mk 24 是一款突击步枪，远距离作战时杀伤力更强，但弹匣容量有限。
RSPR：RSPR 是一款高度紧凑的近距离个人防卫武器，使用步枪弹药，制止力更强大。这款武器在更远射程上比大多数个人防御武器 (PDW) 表现更好，但代价是后坐力更高。想成为战场高手，必须在后坐力控制与停止威力之间找到平衡。
Z84M：一款弹链供弹的轻机枪。Z84M 是一款近距离作战的强力武器。拥有 100 发弹药容量并能够安装多种配件，Z84M 是一款高机动性的杀戮机器。
ELR-40：ELR-40 是一款用途广泛的栓动式狙击步枪，在远距离作战中尤其致命。它拥有极远的最佳射程，而单发模式还能将最佳射程区间缩短，是全能型侦察兵的理想武器。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261013/1791900237_714136_jpg_r.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 首款支持DLSS 5国产游戏官宣！画质突破太惊艳
items.summary: 《燕云十六声》正式宣布，预计于11月正式支持英伟达DLSS 5技术

content.v: 网易旗下开放世界武侠游戏《燕云十六声》正式宣布，预计于11月正式支持英伟达DLSS 5技术，本作将成为国内首款、目前网易唯一一款正式支持DLSS 5技术的游戏。
视频欣赏：
截图欣赏：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132152087810.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132152092514.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132152109590.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132152115440.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132152121806.png
官方表示，此次DLSS 5支持并非简单的技术接入，该版本历经与英伟达官方多轮深度定制化打磨调优，在效果与性能表现上均更为出色。在DLSS 5加持下，游戏的材质与光影表现将迎来重大革新，整个江湖的场景真实感与画面沉浸感都会有明显提升。官方同时透露，双方团队仍在持续进行全方位的升级调优，后续将持续推送优化更新。
DLSS 5是英伟达于2026年3月在GTC大会上发布的图形技术，被英伟达CEO黄仁勋称为“图形领域的GPT时刻”。该技术引入了实时神经渲染模型，通过分析游戏每一帧的色彩和运动矢量，利用AI为场景注入逼真的光影和材质，可在4K分辨率下实时运行。DLSS 5于2026年9月4日正式上线，首发支持游戏为《NBA 2K27》，仅支持GeForce RTX 50系列显卡。
《燕云十六声》早在2026年3月DLSS 5首次公布时便已列入英伟达公布的首批支持游戏名单，此后官方持续推送适配进展。此次确认11月上线，意味着该游戏的DLSS 5支持将从技术合作阶段正式进入落地阶段。

items.title: 《霍格沃茨之遗》计划11月5日支持DLSS 5，新演示人脸变化较3月减弱
items.summary: 英伟达已确认，在DLSS 5于9月随《NBA 2K27》首次亮相后，下一批支持该技术的游戏将包括《霍格沃茨之遗》和《燕云十六声》。前者将于11月5日获得更新，后者将于11月下旬获得支持。英伟达还将为RTX Remix加入

content.v: 英伟达已确认，在DLSS 5于9月随《NBA 2K27》首次亮相后，下一批支持该技术的游戏将包括《霍格沃茨之遗》和《燕云十六声》。前者将于11月5日获得更新，后者将于11月下旬获得支持。英伟达还将为RTX Remix加入DLSS 5，让模组制作者能够把神经渲染技术应用于较早的PC游戏。
《霍格沃茨之遗》将在GeForce RTX50系列显卡、RTX Spark笔记本电脑和GeForce NOW上支持DLSS 5。此次更新还会将游戏现有的DLSS技术升级至最新版本。开发商Avalanche Software利用DLSS 5 SDK提供的控制功能调整了神经渲染效果，以保留游戏原有的视觉风格。
DLSS 5使用3D引导的神经渲染，结合游戏引擎数据改变光照和材质的外观。该模型会同时处理渲染后的画面，以及几何结构、纹理和光照信息。开发者可以控制哪些物体应用额外效果，以及效果的强度。
最新的《霍格沃茨之遗》演示看起来也与英伟达在3月最初展示DLSS 5时不同。新的对比显示，角色面部的改动幅度要小得多，面部特征更接近游戏原有的渲染效果。这种差异在面部细节上尤为明显，而面部细节恰恰是原演示中改动最显著的部分之一。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261013/1791899080_551194_jpg_r.jpg

items.title: Pokémon TCG: Elite Trainer Box 在沃尔玛现价降至 120 美元——与亚马逊相比节省 20 美元
items.summary: Pre-order the Pokémon TCG Delta Reign Elite Trainer Box for $119.99 at Walmart, nearly $20 less than Amazon an

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/12/pokmon-tcg-elite-trainer-box-120-at-walmart-cover-1791847466883.jpg
The first wave of Pokémon TCG Delta Reign preorders didn't leave collectors with much choice when it came to prices, but that's already starting to change with a new low retailer price on its ETB.

The lowest price for Delta Reign’s Elite Trainer Box at Amazon right now is $139.94 , through third-party seller Collectors Expedition. However, Walmart has just undercut that just-shy-of-$140 price by nearly $20.
Right now, the Delta Reign ETB is just $119.99 at Walmart via Cataclysm Games . That’s not only the lowest price we’ve seen so far, but also under TCGplayer’s estimated market price of $122.17.

Speaking of the trading card marketplace, Walmart’s new low price beats any suitable listings there as well — with the lowest being $122.04 at the time of writing . That said, keep in mind that delivery for the Walmart ETB is currently set for 19 November — 13 days after the Delta Reign expansion hits the Pokémon TCG as a whole.

Whichever site you choose to buy your new Delta Reign Elite Trainer Box from, though, the contents will be exactly the same: nine titular Pokémon Trading Card Game Booster packs, a full-art foil Kyogre promo card, 65 card sleeves, Energy cards, dice, a player's guide, and other usual ETB accessories. Without counting those extras, that works out to around $14.44 per booster pack.
Since the current market price for single Delta Reign booster packs sits at $14.01 on TCGplayer , an extra 43 cents each is a pretty good deal for all those bonuses you’re getting.

As for the expansion itself, Delta Reign is bringing over 135 cards to the Pokémon TCG, headlined by Mega Rayquaza ex, with extra Mega Evolutions like Mega Golurk ex, Mega Malamar ex, and Mega Golisopod ex are also joining the collection, alongside more than 35 Pokémon and Trainer cards featuring special illustrations.

content.v: 由于地图规模庞大，《GTA6》的文件大小可能会创下3A游戏的新纪录。
大葱哥“Cyberleek”威胁要泄露一个超过200GB的R星开发版本。不过，压缩技术或许能让Xbox和PS5主机上的正式版下载文件小得多。
随着Cyberleek不断上传游戏视频，最近泄露的《GTA6》游戏文件大小也随之曝光。一条新消息称，用于制作这些视频的开发版本大小超过200 GB。这可能会让Xbox和PS5主机玩家感到有点压力，但正式发售前的下载版本大小或许会更小。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261013/1791889107_311597_jpg_r.jpg
如果Cyberleek的“梗币”市值达到3000万美元，他承诺会发布一个超过200GB的完整可玩版本。这里的文件大小指的是盗版网站上分享的软件包大小，也可能指的是泄露者硬盘上占用的存储空间。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261013/1791889117_815786.jpg
庞大 开放世界 的代价
该项目规模庞大，可能会导致《GTA6》的文件大小惊人。在八月份的一次采访中，Rockstar North工作室联合负责人Rob Nelson证实，地图面积大约是《给他爱5》开放世界的两倍。罪恶 都市 和莱昂尼达周边地区也拥有极其丰富的细节。
作为对比，PS5上的升级版《给他爱5》占用主机约95 GB的空间。而PC用户则需要105 GB空间。考虑到某些《使命召唤： 黑色行动》系列作品的容量已经超过200 GB，《GTA6》的容量翻倍也并非史无前例。尽管如此，在 11月19日《GTA6》正式发售之前，许多玩家恐怕不得不做出一些妥协。
由于零部件短缺，Xbox和PS5的存储扩展成本日益高昂。那些对缺少光盘选项感到失望的玩家，如今又多了一个理由后悔选择了盒装数字版兑换码。即使需要额外下载，受每月流量限制的玩家仍然更倾向于蓝光光盘。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: GTA 6 粉丝们对 11 月的另一个日期感到兴奋，但今天不是发布日
items.summary: Take-Two has announced the details for its next earnings briefing, and as you might expect, GTA 6 fans are cir

content.v: Take-Two has announced the details for its next earnings briefing, and as you might expect, GTA 6 fans are circling the date on their calendars.

The next Take-Two quarterly earnings report will be released on Monday, November 9, with management holding a call at 1:30 PM PT / 4:30 PM ET that day to discuss the results and answer questions. Anyone can listen to the call online.

The report is being released 10 days before GTA 6 launches on November 19, so it's expected that analysts and investors will ask questions about the upcoming launch. Management, including CEO Strauss Zelnick, will likely have some kind of update or commentary to share.
However, fans should not hold out hope for any big details about the game itself, as those kinds of details historically come by way of developer Rockstar Games.

The next Take-Two earnings report is expected in February 2027, but if GTA 6 is the enormous success that everyone expects it to be, the company will likely share details about the game's commercial impact before then.
For GTA 5, Take-Two announced sales right away, confirming $800 million in revenue after the first 24 hours and $1 billion in revenue after three days .

If Sensor Tower's data is accurate, GTA 6 has already sold more than 6 million copies via pre-purchases, bringing in close to $600 million in revenue. Sensor Tower said the game could reach 25 million preorders by release, meaning the game will have made more than $2 billion before launch.

Take-Two investors are understandably excited about GTA 6's release, but the game stands to make even more money once the next evolution of GTA Online launches . To be sure, Rockstar has not yet announced any details about GTA 6's online component, and GTA 6 has been described as a single-player experience.

That being said, given the gigantic success of GTA Online in terms of popularity among fans and its moneymaking ability, it's a safe bet that Rockstar will bring online functionality to GTA 6 at some point.

Beyond any possible updates about GTA 6, the Take-Two earnings report and following call is expected to include updates on the company's numerous other franchises and studios. After all, the GTA franchise represents a very small part of Take-Two's overall business, accounting for less than 15% of total revenue. That number is for a typical quarter–when GTA 6 launches, it will significantly increase.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: 丹·豪瑟 (Dan Houser) 透露 Rockstar 为制作《恶霸》而付出的努力
items.summary: 20 years later, Dan Houser reveals how intense controversy made Bully one of Rockstar’s toughest games to make

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/bully-blog-1791889669780.jpg

Rockstar is gearing up for the launch of GTA 6, but, of course, Grand Theft Auto isn’t the only series the developer is known for. Alongside the likes of the beloved Red Dead Redemption games, there are many fans of another open-world adventure from the studio: Bully.

Released in 2006 and originally known in Europe as Canis Canem Edit, Bully tells the story of unruly student Jimmy Hopkins getting in and out of trouble during a year at Bullworth Academy. A smaller-scale, less X-rated version of GTA, it launched to critical acclaim. But the road towards launch was far from easy.

“The development was hard,” former Rockstar VP and writer of Bully, Dan Houser, said in a new interview as part of our IGN30 Icons Series. “The game was in trouble all of the time. It was difficult. It was an out-there concept. We were struggling with it. I wasn't sure it was going to be any good. We really wanted it to come together. It was really fun afterwards because it came together really well. The team did a great job. It was a sort of really strong game at the end. It kind of came together very late.”

Houser went on to explain why the development of Bully proved such a challenge, coming as it did just over a year after GTA: San Andreas. “New IP is very stressful because you're doing something that no one's ever done before,” he said. “And particularly that game, there was all of this controversy around it to do with the name, or people misunderstood it when they'd never seen it. So I think one of the challenges with that game was it never got the attention it deserved. We were too focused on trying to at least get people to stock it or to not protest it before it even came out.”

The mid-2000s was an era when controversy followed Rockstar games whenever one was about to hit store shelves, whether it be the snuff-film-fuelled ultraviolence of Manhunt, or the sex minigame mod, Hot Coffee, uncovered in the code of San Andreas. Bully was no different, with some members of the public worried about how its explicit content would translate into a school setting.

“There was huge hysteria around it,” Houser stated. “We had to spend most of 2006 diffusing it, so we couldn't positively promote the game in the way we normally would've done. I think that didn't help it. I mean, that was the same time as Hot Coffee, and it felt like things were imploding. It was very stressful. And just go to work each day, wonder who's protesting you that day, and hope that things can shake out properly. I wasn't directly involved. Luckily, I was just sort of right off to the side, and wasn't directly involved in organizing most of that stuff. But it was really stressful for the people involved.”

But it wasn’t just external pressures that made the development of Bully difficult. Rockstar also had to wrestle with how to make its style of open-world action-adventure work from the perspective of a teenager. The school setting meant driving cars and shooting guns had to be parked to one side — two vital gameplay mechanics of any GTA.

“Developers were struggling with what the IP was, and we'd made some changes, and some people had moved out there from New York, and it was starting to get a bit better, but it was still really struggling,” revealed Houser. “It was really, well, if you take away the cars and you take away the guns, what is the game? What are you doing? And the lead designer, who was really talented, began to put in the schedule and began to put in the lessons, and it was starting to get there.

“Then, one of the designers put this thing where you could stick a Post-it note on the back of a character that said ‘Kick me’ on it. Then an NPC would run up and kick them. And just seeing that work, you're like, that's a great moment. So then you're, okay, we're starting to get somewhere. So I think that moment was probably when I always remember going, this IP that wouldn't work in a GTA, obviously; it's not interesting. But as a kid, and suddenly it was the scale of the school and the scale of a kid's life, it started to feel really fun.”

Bully was indeed very fun. So much so that fans have been begging for a sequel ever since. While ideas for a follow-up were once floated around at Rockstar, Houser revealed to IGN in 2025 that it never got off the ground due to “bandwidth issues.”

I do miss the days when you’d get a new Rockstar open world to roam around in every year, but I guess at some point I have to give up yearning for the PS2 era. It was 20 years ago, after all. Luckily, Grand Theft Auto 6 is only weeks away from release.
For more on GTA 6, you can read our full interview with Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson , how the game will tackle the current political climate , and why Dan Houser says he won’t be playing it .

items.title: 将完美射击与权限范围 Premium Warbond 结合起来！
items.summary: Picture this: A chilly autumn breeze ripples through the forest as a battalion of Automatons amble towards an

content.v: Picture this: A chilly autumn breeze ripples through the forest as a battalion of Automatons amble towards an outpost. They move together like cogs in a larger wheel, chanting in their electric tongues as they march, when a peal of thunder breaks their mechanical trance.
But it’s not thunder. It’s you, Helldiver– Liberty’s sharpest shooter taking aim from inside the tree line, busting them down to bolts and puddles of bubbling oil.

On October 20, the Ministry of Defense will authorize deployment of the Scope of Authority Premium Warbond* - the next leap forward in long-range and clandestine combat solutions to guarantee your squad never misses the mark.

The best sniper knows the balance of stability and power is a delicate one, and a primary sniper rifle that can balance both is a tall order. After extensive research and trials in the Ministry of Defense, they have developed an elegant solution: The R-40 Sightliner bolt-action sniper rifle. Your trusty sidekick with the eagle eyes, the Sightliner can provide powerful armor piercing rounds and long-range precision.

The perfect companion to the exactitude of a sniper rifle primary is something that can provide that same steadfastness with the speed and versatility of a pistol. That brings us to the purpose-built P-44 Mist , a one-handed machine pistol designed for a compact carry. If the enemy closes in on you, carve a path out with the help of the P-44!

As we have faced larger and more heavily-armored foes, we have responded by making a more powerful and armor-penetrating, backpack-fed, colossal anti-materiel rifle featuring assisted reload: the AMW-20 Apex . The Apex is far from subtle, but there is not much in the galaxy that could survive an assault from it.

For the advanced tech-loving teams, there is a new entry to the LAS series of energy weapons: the LAS-44 Nova ! This sleek rifle has the luxury of infinite ammo provided by weapons of its type, but it fires a high-precision non-explosive thermal projectile after a short charge cycle. A new optimization routine designed specifically for better cooldown performance means your rifle will be firing longer after all targets have been eliminated.
When thrown, the G-11 Caltrops scatters a wide field of proximity-detonated submunitions that slow and stun foes, making them easier to get in your sights.

Long distance shooters know better than anyone how much time you spend in the cover of nature to get your shot. That’s why the SS-33 Mimetic Marshal light armor is inspired by old-fashioned ghillie suits without sacrificing on modern tactical polish. Utilizing state-of-the-art light-diffusing netting and adaptive fiber technology, the Mimetic Marshall, and the coordinating Mimetic Mesh cape and player card, will let you blend into your surroundings while keeping you light enough on your feet to move in on your mark.

If your tactical approach mixes in more forward marching than camping in the bushes, the SS-15 Focal Point medium armor can round out the edges of your loadout with integrated adaptive camouflage and cutting-edge optics in a stylish asymmetrical visor. The Focal Point armor looks best paired with the Boundary Banner cape and player card.

No matter which one you choose for the job, both armors are equipped with the Stationary Shroud passive, which reduces weapon sway and detection range by mimicking foliage concealment while in the crouched or prone position. Crouch down and watch as your Helldiver disappears into the wilderness around you: the perfect cover.
Along with the impressive stratagems, weapons, and armors, you’ll also get the Manual Ballistic Projection emote and a new title to claim to demonstrate your prowess as a distance shooter: Longshot .
Helldivers, your scope of authority has just been widened – time to set your sights on enemies of Managed Democracy once and for all. The Scope of Authority Premium Warbond launches October 20 !
*Requires base game, Super Credits and game progression to unlock.

content.v: 老派RTS《Defilade》公布，本作以现代战争为背景，深受《红色警戒1》《突袭2》影响，2周内收获10万+愿望单。
游戏拥有深度AI掩护机制和完全可破坏环境系统，士兵会寻找掩体、救援负伤战友、扑倒躲避手榴弹、翻越障碍、挖掘战壕。组建部队，守护补给线，玩家将在完全可破坏、鲜活真实的广阔战场上作战。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261013/1791886126_662481_jpg_r.jpg
关于此游戏
深度掩体AI机制
没有脚本，没有预设的假掩体点，只有想活下去的士兵。
真实的墙，真实的掩体
每一堵墙、每只木箱、每辆汽车、每具残骸、每条战壕、每扇窗户都能当作掩体，因为士兵会根据周围物体的实际形状来判断。一旦被敌人从侧翼包抄，这处掩体会立刻失效。
他们像真正的士兵一样作战
在矮墙后，他们蹲下，起身开火，再伏低。在高墙边，他们会从墙角探出，侧身射击，再缩回掩体。蹲下就真的看不见，站起来就真的会暴露。
他们会听，会记，也想活下去
他们会转向看不见的枪声，通过无线电分享发现的敌情，并记住子弹从哪里飞来。除非你下令，否则他们不会大摇大摆地穿过火力杀伤区。
每一发子弹都算数
擦身而过的子弹会压得人抬不起头，把他们钉在原地。弹药会真的打光：弹药告急的阵地会渐渐沉寂，长点射变成单发，路过尸体的士兵会顺手摸走弹匣。
绝不丢下任何人
负伤不等于阵亡。至少现在还不是。
倒下，但没有阵亡
生命值耗尽的士兵会倒地，大喊医护兵，并开始失血。只要还有力气，他就会拖着身子爬向掩体。
救援
他的小队会先打出掩护火力，等到足够安全，就有人冲出去抓住他的肩膀把他拖回来，另一名战友在一旁倒退着边走边射击。伤员被拖走时也会一直用手枪还击。
就地救治
有人跪在他身边包扎伤口、做心肺复苏，他就能重新站起来继续战斗。医护兵的速度快一倍。但他每倒下一次，身体就更虚弱一分，好运迟早会用完。
医疗帐篷
建好医疗帐篷后，担架兵会冲出去接回你的伤员，甚至阵亡者，把他们抬回来，治好后再送回战场。两人抬担架，只剩一人时就拖着走;如果其中一人中弹，另一人会继续前进。
会开口的俘虏
抓活的。他们知道不少事。
举起手来
被切断退路、陷入包围、又遭到火力压制时，士兵可能会扔下步枪，举起双手，求你别开枪。这种情况很少见：只有在战友全部倒下、也不会有人来救他时，他才会投降。
押送回营
你的一名士兵会给他戴上手铐，押他回基地，一路审问。他会全部交代：他们还剩多少人、有什么装甲、基地在哪里、空中有什么、弹药和资金还剩多少，以及下一步有什么计划。这些情报在那一刻全都是真的。
用得上的情报
他一供出敌方基地的位置，基地就会出现在你的雷达上。不过这是双向的：你的士兵要是落到敌人手里，也会全盘托出，而敌方指挥官会据此行动。
新兵，还是地下牢房
把他移交后，他就会倒戈：“I'M WITH YOU NOW.”（我现在跟你们是一边的了。）叛军则会把俘虏留下，让他们跪在有人看守的地道牢房里，一遍又一遍地审问，随时掌握你的部队此刻的位置。
细节
正是这些小细节，让战场活了起来。
手榴弹会被扔回来。把手榴弹丢向一个胆子够大的家伙，他会从地上捡起来，直接扔回给你。
被炸飞。爆炸会把士兵掀飞到空中。有些人还能爬起来，头晕目眩，踉踉跄跄地想要站稳。
翻越、滑铲、扑倒、肉搏。他们会翻越墙壁、滑铲进入掩体、扑倒躲开手榴弹，距离太近时还会展开肉搏。
捡起武器。机枪手倒下后，会有人冲上去捡起他的机枪接着打。
有分量的坦克。坦克能撞穿墙壁，炮弹会在装甲上跳弹，履带一旦脱落就会趴窝，被击毁的坦克甚至会把炮塔整个炸飞。从后方攻击能更快摧毁坦克，所以你的 RPG 射手会设法绕到它背后。
头顶的无人机。FPV 操作员会驾驶自杀式无人机撞向你的士兵和坦克。士兵能听到它们逼近，会试图把它们击落，并在最后一刻扑倒躲开。
他们会说话。当他们喊出命令、中弹或呼叫医护兵时，头顶会弹出对话气泡。
基地建设
在 Defilade 里，没有任何东西是凭空建成的。放下一座建筑，你的士兵就会走过去亲手把它建起来，而战斗仍在他们周围继续。
前沿作战基地（FOB）就是一切
前沿基地既是部队可以据守作战的坚固阵地，也是他们跑回来补充弹药的地方;每建成一座，你的部队上限就会提高。失去最后一座 FOB，游戏就结束了。
补给就是生命线
每建成一座 FOB，都会铺出一条通往己方防线的道路，补给卡车随即开始往返运输。一切开销都靠这些补给。卡车可能遭到伏击;一旦敌人切断补给链，断点之后的每座 FOB 都会断供瘫痪。
建设阵地，构筑工事
兵营、工厂、研究设施、直升机停机坪和医疗帐篷。战壕、混凝土墙、铁丝网、地雷、反坦克障碍、机枪巢和瞭望塔。叛军甚至会挖掘复杂的地道网络。
然后守住它
你建造的一切都可能被打得粉碎，也都能修补回来;任何一座 FOB，都归攻进去并守住它的一方所有。AI 遵循与你完全相同的规则，而且它盯上了你的 FOB。你可以和朋友在线合作，也可以和朋友对战。
挖好战壕。守住防线。别丢掉你最后一座 FOB。
系统需求
最低配置:
操作系统: Windows 10 (64-bit)
处理器: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X (4 cores)
内存: 8 GB RAM
显卡: 2 GB VR AM, Vulkan support: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360

items.title: 《战神》新作典藏版没游戏！玩家愤怒:PS让人伤心
items.summary: 《战神：劳菲》典藏版现已开启预定，但游戏本体需要单独购买，你能接受这种不含游戏，只包含手办美术周边的游戏收藏礼盒吗？

content.v: 由你来说： 《战神：劳菲》典藏版现已开启预定，但游戏本体需要单独购买， 你能接受这种不含游戏，只包含手办美术周边的游戏收藏礼盒吗？
PlayStation官方账号今日宣布，《战神：劳菲》典藏版现已开启预定。但官方标注的一行小字，直接点燃了海外玩家社区：游戏本体需要单独购买，并不包含在这个收藏礼盒内。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132051151160.png
消息一出，大量海外玩家在社交平台表达不满。不少玩家吐槽，这种不带游戏的“收藏版”堪称离谱，批评索尼此举是收割粉丝；还有玩家拿《最后生还者2》典藏版进行对比，直言该方案比当年的争议操作还要糟糕，甚至质疑厂商这样的定价策略是在消耗品牌口碑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132051267787.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132051273799.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132051303106.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132051309019.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132051309015.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132051326854.png
玩家普遍认为，典藏礼盒的核心理应配套游戏本体，单独拆分售卖的模式难以让人接受。还有玩家表示，PlayStation已经彻底成为了一个笑话。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132051397969.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132051429766.jpg
你能接受这种不含游戏，只包含手办美术周边的游戏收藏礼盒吗？欢迎在评论区分享你的看法。

items.title: XBOX新主机爆料：入门款比PS5 pro都强 能玩PC游戏
items.summary: 随着2026年进入下半年，关于微软下一代Xbox主机的爆料信息正在快速累积

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132047009929.png
随着2026年进入下半年，关于微软下一代Xbox主机的爆料信息正在快速累积。据GameGPU、TweakTown及Vandal等多家外媒报道，代号 “Project Helix” 的次世代Xbox并非单一主机，而是一个包含三款不同定位设备的硬件家族，预计于2027年底正式发售。
旗舰Helix X：56 TFLOPS，对标PS6
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132048024207.png

作为家族的旗舰型号，Project Helix X的GPU算力据爆料达到56 TFLOPS，约为现款Xbox Series X（12 TFLOPS）的4.6倍。得益于AMD架构的dual-issue FP32能力，其峰值算力可达112 TFLOPS，理论性能超过RTX 5090。据知名爆料人Kepler_L2透露，PS6的GPU算力约为40 TFLOPS，Helix X在纸面上领先约40% 。规格方面，Helix X采用Zen 6 + Zen 6c混合CPU架构和68个RDNA 5计算单元，内存为最高48GB GDDR7，总线位宽192-bit，并配备专用NPU加速AI任务。据ixbt.games报道，该机将搭载新一代FPS Boost技术，可自动将Xbox Series X游戏提升至120甚至240 FPS，无需开发者介入。价格方面，TweakTown估算其物料成本约900美元，零售价最低999美元，1200美元被认为更现实。
入门级Helix S：18 TFLOPS，有望超越PS5 Pro

Project Helix S定位更亲民，据GameGPU分析，其GPU算力约为18 TFLOPS（dual-issue下可达36 TFLOPS），配备20GB GDDR7内存和1TB NVMe SSD。尽管算力数值不及PS5 Pro的18.05 TFLOPS峰值，但由于采用更新的RDNA 5架构和更高效的AI超分技术（FSR Diamond），GameGPU认为其在光线追踪效率和实际游戏表现中有望超越PS5 Pro。Helix S将采用全数字设计，不含光驱，价格预计在499至599美元之间。
Helix掌机：10 TFLOPS，接近PS5水平
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/13/small_202610132048223442.png
第三款设备是Project Helix Handheld，一款定位便携的游戏掌机，GPU算力约10 TFLOPS，与基础版PS5（10.28 TFLOPS）接近。该设备的设计目标是在续航与性能之间取得平衡，TDP经过专门优化以确保电池寿命。目前关于掌机的具体屏幕规格、重量和价格信息仍然有限。

三款设备最引人注目的共同特性，是深度整合Windows生态。微软官方已确认Project Helix将支持运行Xbox与PC双平台游戏，并可能原生访问Steam和Epic Games Store等第三方商店。不过，据Windows Central的Jez Corden分析，出于成本控制考虑，微软可能不会在首发时完全开放Steam支持。此外，AMD定制的 “Magnus”芯片已成功完成流片，锁定了最终硅结构，为2027年的量产铺平了道路。
需要强调的是，以上所有信息均来自未经微软官方确认的爆料与泄露，实际产品规格、价格和发售时间仍需以官方公布为准。微软此前已确认将在2027年向开发者提供Alpha版开发套件，但消费者版本的具体细节仍未公开。

items.title: 《战神》的劳菲收藏版遗漏了一件重要的事情：游戏
items.summary: The God of War Laufey Collector's Edition has been revealed, but unlike the standard and digital deluxe editio

content.v: The God of War Laufey Collector's Edition has been revealed, but unlike the standard and digital deluxe editions that went up for preorder last month , this is purely a box of merch. The main attraction of this collector's edition is an eight-inch statue of Faye, Phranque the Cube, and Rue fighting against Begtse’s soldiers. Phranque will light up when connected to a USB power source.

The set also includes a deck of 51 illustrated oracle cards and a mini art book depicting the characters, creatures, and environments of God of War Laufey, all housed in collector's edition-packaging. As noted in the image, God of War Laufey is sold separately, and this edition costs $150. You'll need to shell out another $70 for a physical edition of the game to complete it. Preorders are now live on the PlayStation Direct Store ahead of the game's February 2027 release.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Laufey-CE-2.jpg?w=636

Sony has released several collector's editions in the past that bundled a digital download key for a game. A merchandise-only box set isn't uncommon, as just a few weeks ago, Rockstar Games revealed the $400 GTA 6 collector's edition that comes with plenty of stuff .

So what's the thinking behind one of these boxes? These boxes typically target dedicated, high-spending superfans who can afford to shell out extra for bonus physical content like this, acting as high-margin merchandise. At the same time, publishers can save some cash by not including the game, streamlining their supply chains and lowering production overhead in the process. Essentially, a bigger slice of the pie for companies, while consumers with deep pockets get limited-edition swag to display.

In other God of War news, the next game in the series will see Kratos return to the spotlight, and it'll pick up directly after the end of God of War Laufey. A live-action God of War TV series is also in development for Prime Video, and its new leading man, Dave Bautista, is already working to get shredded for the role after the original Kratos actor , Ryan Hurst, departed due to injury.
